reason_for_supersession: User clarified that TV-Free scoring features must be based on four-hour data; daily OHLCV is accepted here only for endpoint evaluation and data-gap auditing.
feature_timeframe: Four-hour bars are required for scoring features, ranks, and signal-time candidate selection. Daily-only feature experiments do not qualify as four-hour system candidates.
daily_data_role: Same-symbol/same-session availability audit against missing four-hour bars
Any future feature fallback must have a separately frozen policy, source indicator, and validation; no silent timeframe mixing

target.entry: Open of the next official XTKS business session after the signal date.
target.exit: Close of the fifth official XTKS business session after the signal date, counting the entry session as session one.
target.entry_exit_price_source: Already available daily OHLCV only; no 1-hour or 4-hour fill prices.
target.signal_time_effect: Morning and afternoon signals on the same session use the same daily entry and exit dates/prices.

endpoint_label.required_prices: Positive finite entry-session open and fifth-session close on the exact calendar dates.
endpoint_label.intermediate_daily_bars: Not required to calculate endpoint mark-to-market; missing interior sessions remain explicitly path-incomplete.
endpoint_label.volume: Does not erase the endpoint mark-to-market result; zero or unknown endpoint/interior volume is exposed as an execution-quality diagnostic.
endpoint_label.missing_or_invalid_endpoint: Keep row unresolved with a target-specific status; never forward-fill or jump sessions.

path_and_execution_diagnostics.strict_label: Retain existing strict labeler unchanged; inspect all five official daily bars and preserve OHLCV, volume, gap, and split-size checks.
path_and_execution_diagnostics.interpretation: A resolved endpoint return is not proof of intraday path, queue priority, limit execution, liquidity, or executable fill. Endpoint and strict-path metrics must be reported separately.

evaluation_scope.unit_tests: Synthetic daily bars, including separate morning and afternoon signals and missing interior sessions.
evaluation_scope.retrospective_audit: Only previously exposed 2022H2 and 2023 results; no feature selection or model promotion.

prohibited: Promoting a daily-feature model as the four-hour TV-Free candidate
Synthesizing hourly or four-hour bars from daily OHLCV
Opening 2024, 2025, or 2026 outcomes for this audit
Changing candidate membership after seeing labels
External price fetching or Yahoo scraping
